info.title: PPOps merchant API
info.description: One merchant receiver, network and token per instance. Amounts are integer atomic-unit strings; timestamps are Unix seconds. Webhooks are at-least-once. See docs/PAYMENT-STATES.md for expiry and settlement semantics.
